articles.title: American detained in Cuba for nearly a decade released
articles.description: After being arrested in Cuba in 2017 and serving years of a 13-year espionage sentence deemed arbitrary by the U.N., U.S. citizen Alina López Miyares was released and returned home in September.

articles.title: American Detained in Cuba Quietly Released
articles.description: “An American held for nearly a decade in Cuba was quietly released earlier this year,” CNN reports. “Alina López Miyares’s release, which has not been previously reported, came amid soaring tensions between Washington and Havana, as the Trump administration has ratcheted up its pressure campaign to try to force changes to the government there.”

articles.title: American Detained in Cuba for Nearly a Decade Released, CNN Reports
articles.description: An American detained in Cuba since 2017 after being accused of espionage has been released, CNN reported on Friday, citing two sources familiar with the matter and a State Department spokesperson. articles.title: Exclusive: American detained in Cuba for nearly a decade quietly released
articles.description: An American held for nearly a decade in Cuba was quietly released earlier this year, two sources familiar with the matter and a State Department spokesperson told CNN.

articles.title: Husband of American detained in Russia says case was not mentioned during Trump meeting with Putin
articles.description: Harold Jezler is the husband of Olga Jezler, an American who has been detained in Russia for over four years. He joins "The Takeout" to share details on his wife's condition and call for her safe return.
